notes.title: We're back and we're hungry for more.
notes.content:
[h3]Knock, knock, sinners, remember us?
[/h3]
It's been almost a year since we released [b]The Sin Collector: Repentless[/b] visual novel, but this wasn't, by any chance, the final word we had to say in the Sin Collector universe... 

Currently, we're hard at work forging [b]a new chapter of the story[/b] (keep in mind that this time around it will be something [b]bigger than the visual novel[/b]). It will take some tinkering (and making sure that everything's kosher) before we can show you something more, but you have been warned... Follow us on other platforms to make sure you're up to date with our scheming.

You can find us here:

https://twitter.com/SinCollectors
https://imgur.com/user/sylenstudio
